'use strict';
import EventEmitter from 'events';
import * as util from './util';
import { add, DEFAULT as D } from './util.js';
import './side-effect';
import data from '../src/data.json' with { type: 'json' };

/** Base shape. */
export class Shape extends EventEmitter {
  /** @type {Point} */
  origin = new Point(0, 0);
  static count = 0;
  #secret = 'hidden';
  name;
  [Symbol.iterator] = null;

  /**
   * @param {Point} origin
   */
  constructor(origin) {
    super();
    this.origin = origin;
    this.store = new Map();
    this.helper = new util.Helper();
    Shape.count++;
  }

  get area() { return 0; }
  set area(v) { this._a = v; }
  static create(...args) { return new Shape(...args); }
  async load() { await util.add(1, D); return this.describe(); }
  *walk() { yield this.origin; }
  #hidden() { return add(1, 2); }
  [Symbol.toPrimitive]() { return 1; }
  'quoted'() { return 2; }
  describe() { return `${this.name}: ${this.area}`; }
}

export class Circle extends Shape {
  constructor(r) {
    super(new Point(0, 0));
    this.r = r;
  }
  describe() { return super.describe() + this.radius(); }
  radius() { return this.r; }
}

class Point { constructor(x, y) { this.x = x; this.y = y; } }

export default class Square extends Shape {}
